input: Sign up for a pottery throwing masterclass

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: Whether the class is in-person or online entirely changes where to search and what options are available.
The user's current skill level determines whether a true 'masterclass' (advanced) or a beginner-friendly session is the right fit.
The user's location narrows down which studios or providers are realistically accessible for an in-person class.
Budget sets a hard ceiling on which classes are viable and whether premium options should even be surfaced.
Availability and preferred timing determine which class schedules are actually compatible with the user's life.
Knowing if this is for one person or a group (e.g. a gift, team event, date) changes the booking type and capacity requirements.
Understanding what the user wants to walk away with — a finished piece, a new skill, a fun experience — shapes which class format and length to prioritise.

gold.taskTitle: Sign up for a pottery throwing masterclass
gold.taskDescription: Find and register for a pottery throwing masterclass that fits the user's needs, schedule, and preferences.

questions.title: Do you want an in-person class or an online one?
questions.description: Determine whether the user wants to attend a physical studio session or follow a virtual masterclass remotely.

questions.title: What is your current experience level with pottery?
questions.description: Establish whether the user is a complete beginner, has some hobby experience, or is already practised — to match the right class level.

questions.title: What city or area should the class be near?
questions.description: Capture the user's location to identify locally accessible studios or providers.

questions.title: What is your budget for this class?
questions.description: Identify the maximum the user is willing to spend so only affordable options are considered.

questions.title: Which days or times work best for you to attend?
questions.description: Understand the user's scheduling availability — weekdays, weekends, evenings — to filter compatible class slots.

questions.title: Is this booking just for you or for a group?
questions.description: Determine if the user is signing up solo, as a pair (e.g. date night, gift), or for a larger group such as a team event.

questions.title: What do you most want to take away from the class?
questions.description: Clarify the user's primary goal — making a finished piece to keep, learning a specific technique, or simply having a fun creative experience — to prioritise the right class format.
